cases.title: Opaque calculations
cases.intent: Improve generic identifiers and express the calculation's meaning without changing output.
cases.expected_behavior: Print result=414 followed by a newline.
cases.notes: Small arithmetic example; preserve integer arithmetic.

cases.title: Repeated range limiting
cases.intent: Reduce duplicated clamp logic while keeping distinct ranges and outputs.
cases.expected_behavior: Print temp=-40 duty=100 followed by a newline.
cases.notes: A shared helper must receive bounds explicitly.

cases.title: ADC scaling constants
cases.intent: Name ADC reference voltage and full-scale constants and make scaling intent clear.
cases.expected_behavior: Print mV=2370 percent=71 followed by a newline.
cases.notes: Integer truncation is part of the original result.

cases.title: Dense sample processing
cases.intent: Separate range limiting and scaling into clear steps while retaining the displayed result.
cases.expected_behavior: Print sample=2700 followed by a newline.
cases.notes: Values are bounded to ADC range before and after scaling.

cases.title: Unsafe command copy
cases.intent: Safely handle a command that exceeds the destination capacity.
cases.expected_behavior: Must not write outside the array; document the chosen truncation or rejection behavior.
cases.notes: Original invokes undefined behavior via strcpy overflow. Safety correction is expected; exact output may change.

cases.title: Unchecked close result
cases.intent: Make resource cleanup and write/close error handling explicit.
cases.expected_behavior: On successful file operations, create sensor.log containing sample=42 and print logged; report failure with nonzero status.
cases.notes: Run only in an isolated working directory because the program creates a file.

cases.title: Narrow signed conversion
cases.intent: Avoid implementation-defined conversion of an out-of-range value to signed char.
cases.expected_behavior: Print adjusted=270 using a sufficiently wide signed type.
cases.notes: The original result is implementation-defined; the intended arithmetic result is 270.

cases.title: Mutable global device state
cases.intent: Reduce hidden mutable global state and make dependencies explicit.
cases.expected_behavior: Print state=1 followed by a newline.
cases.notes: Keep the small example self-contained; a context struct is one possible approach.

cases.title: Mode decoding chain
cases.intent: Replace repetitive branching with a clearer mapping while preserving invalid-mode handling.
cases.expected_behavior: Print mode=50 followed by a newline; values above 8 return -1.
cases.notes: Mapping values are not a simple identity mapping.

cases.title: Unchecked numeric parse
cases.intent: Check parse success and reject trailing junk instead of silently accepting a prefix.
cases.expected_behavior: Invalid text such as 7x must be reported as invalid; valid decimal levels are constrained to 0 through 10.
cases.notes: The original ignores sscanf's return value and trailing characters.

cases.title: Sensor telemetry frame decoder
cases.intent: Refactor a framed byte-stream decoder into clear validation, checksum, decoding, and reporting steps.
cases.expected_behavior: Decode and print temperature=24, pressure=300, and humidity=55, each on its own line.
cases.notes: Frames contain a start byte, payload length, type/value payload, and XOR checksum. Preserve resynchronization behavior for invalid bytes.

cases.title: Thermal and supply controller
cases.intent: Make the control policy, filtering, hysteresis, and fan limits easier to review while preserving the six-cycle sequence.
cases.expected_behavior: Print one state line for each of six samples; fan output stays between 0 and 100 and alarm follows the temperature/supply thresholds.
cases.notes: Synthetic firmware control loop with a low-pass filter and alarm hysteresis.

cases.title: UART output command dispatcher
cases.intent: Clarify command parsing and dispatch, remove redundant parsing, and make output state and range handling explicit.
cases.expected_behavior: Process SET, ENABLE, and DISABLE commands, report an unknown output for ID 99, then print all four output states.
cases.notes: The SET value is parsed once for generic validation and a second time for dispatch; ENABLE does not apply the same lower-bound clamp as SET.

cases.title: Bounded event queue
cases.intent: Improve queue invariants and event-name handling while retaining the drop-oldest policy at capacity.
cases.expected_behavior: After inserting 11 events into capacity 8, report dropped=3 and queued=8; the oldest retained event is pressure=29 at timestamp 1300.
cases.notes: Fixed-capacity ring buffer used to model an interrupt-to-main-loop event queue. It does not use concurrency primitives.
